headings.style_rules: Uppercase, tracking-tight, font-black. Used for main titles and stat callouts.

body.style_rules: Clean, highly readable. Use tabular-nums for data tables.

layout.grid_system: MODE B: THE 'CONTROL ROOM' GRID. Strict hierarchy, gap-4 to gap-6.
layout.surface_strategy: Flat solid surfaces with 1px border (border-white/10). No soft shadows. Use 'Inner Glow' (box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.05)) for premium feel. Avoid glassmorphism for data clarity.
layout.spacing: Dense for data (tables p-2 to p-4), moderate for containers (p-6). Use p-8 for main sections.
layout.navigation: Left sidebar or dense top navbar with clear active states.

components.tables: Shadcn Table. Dark background, hover rows (hover:bg-white/5), sticky headers. Tabular-nums for stats.
components.radar_chart: Recharts RadarChart. Stroke #007AFF, Fill #007AFF with 0.3 opacity. Overlaid comparisons use #32D74B or #FF3B30.
components.buttons: Sharp corners or max 4px radius. Primary buttons: bg-[#007AFF] text-white hover:bg-[#005bb5]. Secondary: bg-transparent border border-white/20 hover:border-white/50.
components.badges: MLB Comp badge: solid gold/yellow accent or primary color, uppercase, bold.
components.video_upload: Dashed border (border-dashed border-white/20), hover state glows primary color. Show processing state with 'ASCII-style' loading or terminal text effect.

motion.hover_states: Crisp, fast transitions. duration-150. Slight border brightness increase.
motion.list_transitions: Staggered fade-in for recruit search results (Framer Motion).
motion.data_loading: Skeleton loaders matching the dark surface, with a subtle shimmer.

dashboard_search.layout: Top filters (Position, Region, Min OPS, Min Velo). Data table below with 20 rows. Clickable rows navigate to Profile.

player_profile.layout: Bento Grid: Top left 'North Star' (Biomech Score & MLB Comp). Top right: Video clip. Bottom left: Radar Chart vs MLB. Bottom right: Granular stats.

compare.layout: Side-by-side selectors. Central overlaid Radar Chart. Side-by-side stat tables with red/green highlights for the winner of each metric.

scouting_board.layout: List/Grid of shortlisted players. Top right: 'Export PDF' button.

video_upload.layout: Centered dropzone. Once uploaded, transitions into a split view: video on left, diagnostic cards (score, 2-3 feedback lines) on right.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text meets 4.5:1 ratio against #0A0A0A. Use bright status colors.
accessibility.testing: MUST include data-testid on all interactive elements (e.g., data-testid='recruit-search-input', data-testid='add-to-shortlist-btn').

icons.style: Stroke-based, consistent width. Use bright colors for status icons.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install Google Fonts: Barlow Condensed and Outfit.
Set up Tailwind dark mode. Use pure black #0A0A0A as main bg, and #121212 for panels/cards.
Install Recharts for the radar chart in player profile.
Ensure all Shadcn components (tables, cards, inputs) are modified to use the 1px solid border style without soft shadows.
Include 'data-testid' on all buttons, links, and forms.
Use tabular-nums class for all statistics and numbers.
For the Map View, use a dark-themed SVG or Mapbox if applicable, otherwise a stylized placeholder.
The codebase uses .js extensions, ensure any new components are created as .js files, not .tsx.
